# Agentopia Contributor License Agreement Signatures

## Description

This file lists the GitHub usernames of everyone who has signed the
[Agentopia Individual Contributor License Agreement](../CLA.md) (CLA).

By opening a pull request that adds your GitHub username to the list below,
you agree to be bound by the terms of the CLA in respect of all Contributions
you have made and will make to Agentopia and the other projects of its
maintainer. Please read the CLA before signing.

To sign, add one line to the end of the list in your first pull request:

- the line is `- ` followed by your GitHub username
- use lowercase, with no leading `@`
- one username per line, and nothing else on the line

The CLA Check workflow reads only the list under "Contributors", so the rest of
this file can change freely. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the
whole process.
